instruction.german: Read the text in Figure it out and complete the rules in the grammar box with these words.

parts:
Figure it out

If I don’t sleep tonight, I’ll be tired tomorrow. If I’m tired tomorrow, I won’t do well in my test. And my teacher will be really angry if I don’t do well in my test. Why can’t I sleep?


Grammar | First conditional

• We use the first conditional to describe possible future events.

• We form the first conditional with If + 1 , 2 + infinitive.

• We always use a 3 when if is at the beginning of the sentence.

Condition clause Result clause

If I eat now, I won’t feel hungry later.

Result clause Condition clause

You will be very if you don’t leave

late for school now.
